Norway wealth fund holds $1.2 billion stake in SpaceX

Norway's sovereign wealth fund, the world's largest, has disclosed a $1.2 billion stake in Elon Musk's SpaceX. The fund, managed by Norges Bank Investment Management, revealed its holdings in a recent filing. This investment highlights the significant financial backing and investor confidence in the private space exploration company.
